summary: Through road with homes 11-20 m away and only odd cars parked.
reasons: Collector road, only occasional parked cars
Cars sparse, so a van would stand out

best_section.where: West kerb below the 50 m crossing, before the garages

drivers.seclusion: Dwellings 11-20 m away on this side; gardens and a tight row of houses behind the kerb.
drivers.access_and_room: Plain kerb with a through lane beside it; one or two cars parked along 110 m.
drivers.traffic: Through route linking roundabouts and suburbs, with moving traffic.
drivers.convention: No signs; no regular overnight parking visible.

flags: Houses within 10-20 m on this side
sun_shade: Heavy tree canopy over the kerb for most of it, mainly from the west.
